text_block_list.text: I'm in the middle of training with T.M. Opera O, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... All things are in flux... yet
my brilliance remains eternal... even in a swamp of ennui—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nay... Trainer, this is a trial bestowed by the heavens.
They are testing me by presenting me with such hardships.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now... run, run, me!
Burn your soul and show them the glory of the "Supreme Overlord"...!
Though she maintained a resolute demeanor, exhaustion was clearly taking its toll... I'll need to reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
